title: Graph positioning errors in the interface and interface freezing
author: artur-aragao
body_snippet:
Errors in the positioning of the interface graph and interface freezing.

Dear friends,

I am writing to inform you that the mRemoteNG 1.78.2 NB 3405 project is experiencing errors with the positioning of the interface graph and interface freezes.

I was only able to resolve this on Windows 11 build 23H2 - 22631.6649 by enabling Windows 7 compatibility mode, disabling full-screen optimizations, and using legacy display ICC color management.
